title: Acely
tagline: Acely is a Education & Community platform that rewards users for their positive contribution to the platform.
description:
Acely is an education and community platform built on top of Lens Protocol, that incentives positive engagement throughout its platform. Its unique voting structure and Tokenomics paired with existing blockchains differentiate Acely from any other platform.
Users can vote/rate content and choose how many tokens they want to stake; based on how beneficial others found their contribution they receive a portion back through staked rewards.  

Users will be able to join communities/groups they are interested in (Web3, Math, Videogames, etc.) and upon completing courses users will be rewarded with NFT certificates that allow the user to participate in community voting and additional features. These NFT certificates are more than just proof of completion, by using Unlock protocol we are able to use NFT's to gain access to select communities, unlock subscription content, and much more.

Tokenomics
Users will receive tokens for creating an account, which enables them to immediately start contributing to the growth of the platform. By using Worldcoin/Polygon ID users have to verify their identity to gain access to Acely, ensuring that only one account is granted per person.

Voting
Users will be able to vote on content staking reputation based on how beneficial they found that content. There will be multiple voting categories: Quality, Difficulty, Time Consumption, and Usefulness. Creators are rewarded with tokens based on the overall rating, and how many people consumed their content. Additionally, users will be able to comment on content through different categories: Questions, Appreciation, Constructive Feedback, and Future Recommendations. Users will also be able to reply to questions, flag comments, upvote, and downvote. Interactions that add value to users, rewards users. 

Leaderboards
There will be a leaderboard where content creators receive recognition & rewards (Tokens, NFTs) for their contribution to the community. 

Tutoring
Acely enables mentors to tutor on the platform, users can tip, vote/rate, and provide feedback directly to the mentor.
how_its_made: We used Worldcoin/Polygon ID for the proof of a unique person and ENS to link your wallet name to your account, all built on Lens protocol. This ensures no duplicate accounts or bots join the network, enabling us to offer users tokens for creating an account. By using Filecoin and Livepeer we are able to securely store and access large data files. With Graph's Subgraph & Unlock protocols' unique NFT features we are able to use NFT's for timed subscriptions, access to groups/communities, one-time purchases, and more. With XMTP and Push notifications users can message friends in their community, mentors, and receive notifications on the latest courses coming out
